They were led by third-year head coach [[Reggie Witherspoon (basketball)|Reggie Witherspoon]] and played their home games at the [[Koessler Athletic Center]] in [[Buffalo, New York]] as members of the [[Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference]] (MAAC). They finished the season 15–17 overall, 11–7 in [[2018–19 Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference men's basketball season|MAAC play]], to finish in a four-way tie for second place.{{Cite web |title=2018-19 Men's Basketball Standings |url=https://maacsports.com/standings.aspx?standings=166 |access-date=2024-10-28 |website=maacsports.com}} As the No. 2 seed in the [[2019 MAAC men's basketball tournament|2019 MAAC tournament]], they defeated No. 7 seed [[2018–19 Manhattan Jaspers basketball team|Manhattan]] in the quarterfinals{{Cite web |date=2019-03-08 |title=Men’s Basketball Advances With Overtime Win over Manhattan |url=https://gogriffs.com/news/2019/3/9/mens-basketball-advances-with-overtime-win-over-manhattan.aspx |access-date=2024-10-28 |website=Canisius University Athletics |language=en}} before falling to No. 6 seed [[2018–19 Monmouth Hawks men's basketball team|Monmouth]] 59–73 in the semifinals.{{cite web |date=March 10, 2019 |title=Quinn lifts Monmouth past Canisius 73-59 in MAAC tourney |url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/quinn-lifts-monmouth-past-canisius-73-59-in-maac-tourney/ |access-date=March 26, 2019 |website=CBSSports.com |agency=AP}} ==Previous season== The [[2017–18 Canisius Golden Griffins men's basketball team|Golden Griffins]] finished the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2017–18 season]] 21–11, 15–3 in [[2017–18 Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference men's basketball season|MAAC play]], to finish in a share for the MAAC regular-season title with [[2017–18 Rider Broncs men's basketball team|Rider]].{{Cite web |title=2017-18 Men's Basketball Standings |url=https://maacsports.com/standings.aspx?standings=151 |access-date=2024-10-28 |website=maacsports.com}} It was their first conference regular-season title since 1994.{{Cite web |date=2018-02-25 |title=Men's Basketball Earns Share of MAAC Regular-Season Crown |url=https://gogriffs.com/news/2018/2/25/mens-basketball-earns-share-of-maac-regular-season-crown.aspx |access-date=2024-10-28 |website=Canisius University Athletics |language=en}} As the No. 2 seed at the [[2018 MAAC men's basketball tournament|MAAC tournament]], they were upset by in the quarterfinals by No. 7 seed [[2017–18 Quinnipiac Bobcats men's basketball team|Quinnipiac]].{{Cite web |date=2018-03-02 |title=Men's Basketball Eliminated from MAAC Championship |url=https://gogriffs.com/news/2018/3/3/mens-basketball-eliminated-from-maac-championship.aspx |access-date=2024-10-28
